newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT says Leykam paper unit had Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT says Leykam paper unit had Q3 loss.

text.p: Dutch NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Thursday its 72-percent owned paper division KNP Leykam made a third quarter operating loss of seven million guilders.
"The sales volumes were good, but the margins remained at a very low level," KNP BT said in a results statement.
In the year-earlier quarter KNP Leykam posted an operating profit of 108 million guilders.
The Dutch paper, office supplies and printing equipment group said in September it would seek a partner for the troubled division.
KNP BT earlier posted third-quarter net profits from ordinary operations of 38 million guilders, down from 116 million guilders in the year-earlier quarter.
